## Download and pre-process NTEMS data for a study area

```{r, eval = FALSE}
## ensure you are working with enough temp scratch storage space!
scratchPath <- ifelse(nzchar(Sys.getenv("SCRATCHDIR")), Sys.getenv("SCRATCHDIR"), tempdir())

## load packages
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(forestData)

## set package options
terraOptions(
  memfrac = 0.2,
  tempdir = scratchPath
)

## random study area in central Alberta
studyArea <- SpatialPoints(data.frame(lon = -115, lat = 55), proj4string = CRS("EPSG:4326")) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_transform(paste("+proj=lcc +lat_1=49 +lat_2=77 +lat_0=0 +lon_0=-95",
                     "+x_0=0 +y_0=0 +units=m +no_defs +ellps=GRS80 +towgs84=0,0,0")) |>
  vect() |>
  randomStudyArea(center = _, seed = 60, size = 1e10) |>
  st_as_sf()

## CA_forest_harvest_recovery_rate.zip is smallest of the NTEMS archives (~49 MB)
postharvestrr <- ntems("harvestrecovery", tempdir(), studyArea = studyArea)
```

```{r cleanup, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
unlink(terra::sources(postharvestrr))
```
